title: Spanish Gold Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Allied Brass
description: This 18.75-inch wall mount shower basket keeps shampoo, soap, and bath essentials organized where you need them. Available in Spanish Gold. Spanish Gold presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired. The oval combination design uses ventilated, heavy-gauge solid brass wires that will never rust, helping bottles drain and dry faster. Solid brass construction is built for daily shower use and long-term durability, with a concealed screw mounting system for a clean, finished look. Sized 18.75 in L x 2.25 in H x 4.13 in W (4.13 in projection). Includes basket and all installation hardware.  and backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
